glosses: To make familiar by use; to cause to accept; to habituate, familiarize, or inure.

examples.text: Early exposure to pet allergens and pet-related bacteria accustoms the body to allergens.
I shall always fear that he who accustoms himself to fraud in little things, wants only opportunity to practice it in greater.
